description.value:
Tonkins are the offshoot race of their tonberry brethren. They are a mostly peaceful race, keeping to themselves, small and green-skinned with fish tails.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Tonkins gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Strength.
  • Type: Tonkins are Humanoid creatures with the tonberry subtype.
  • Size: Tonkins are Small creatures.
  • Base Speed: Tonkins have a base speed of 20 feet on land, never modified by armor or encumbrance.
  • Languages: Tonkins begin play understanding (but not speaking) Common and Tonberry. Tonkins with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Aklo, Auran, Draconic, Goblin, Numish, and Sylvan.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Fearless: Tonkins receive a +2 racial bonus on saves against fear spells and effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Murderous Aura: Tonkins gain a +2 racial bonus to intimidation checks.
  • Sneaky: Tonkins gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

Magical Racial Trait

  • Lantern Bearer: Tonkins are immune to light-based blindness and dazzle effects.
  • Limited Telepathy: Tonkins mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom they share a language.

Movement Racial Trait

  • Swift as Shadows: Tonkins reduce the penalty for using Stealth while moving at full speed by 5.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Serrated Wound: When tonkins damage an opponent with a light piercing melee weapon, they deal an extra 1d4 bleed damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Tonkins can see twice as far as humes in dim light.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Unable to Cast: Tonkins cannot cast spells with a vocal component without Silent Spell or Telepathic Spellcaster feat.
